hard_failures: Problem 3 explicitly requires the row-by-column pairing for at least one product entry, but verification checks only the completed matrix and does not declare the pairing manual.

errors.description: The required intermediate pairing in problem 3 is absent from verification.

critical_observations: Problems 8 and 10 correctly declare their representation subparts manual, making the omission in problem 3 especially clear.
artifact_findings: Every matrix entry, determinant, inventory total, and system solution independently agrees with the key.
All three PDFs are polished, legible, and correctly counted.
rationale: This is otherwise an excellent matrix set, but one explicitly required objective row-column pairing is outside the declared verification boundary. Under the rubric, that single omission requires rejection.
